column1: # Czech glossary. Claude-only proposal, drafted 2026-11-05 alone by Claude, pending the three-vendor debate; not final.
# Same columns as en.tsv: term holds the Czech, forms separated by " | ". Definitions are D3's where D3 changed them.

# Matching: a form ending in a, e, i, o, u, y, á, é, í, ó or ú matches its stem (five letters or more) plus up to four letters. Any other form matches only as written, so its cases are listed. That includes forms ending in ě, ý or ů, which lexicon._ENDING_LETTERS leaves out.
# Rows D3 retires stay, mapped to the chosen term, until D3 merges and en.tsv drops them. D3's new rows and renamed ids wait in l10n/pending/glossary-d3/cs.tsv.

# HOLD until D3 merges: en.tsv and the strings still use Top speed and Maximum speed in their old senses, while the top-speed and maximum-speed rows below already use D3's. Following those rows now would call the setting Nejvyšší dosažená rychlost and the measured value Maximální rychlost, the swap section 7 of the style guide forbids.

# So do not draft or merge these keys before D3: dashboard_model_tile_top_speed, controls_experimental_speed_limit, the readings_maximum_speed_kmh ladder (with _short and _compact), and main_speed_* if they arrive first. They stay English (council verdict fallback). pack.py has no per-key filter, so a run over those areas must rule them out by hand.

# Not held: rides_tile_max_speed says Max speed for the speed measured on a ride, and D3 only renames it to Top speed. Draft it now as Nejv. dosažená, never Max. rychlost. No row matches "Max speed", so check.py will not catch the swap.
